verdict.rationale: ChatGD is described as a built-in generative-AI chat assistant using enterprise OpenAI models with RAG for querying/manipulating documents, but the evidence frames it as a tool for the firm's own attorneys rather than something end-users/clients can invoke inside a client-facing product to delegate tasks. Missing for 10: evidence that clients (the actual product users) can access or delegate tasks to ChatGD or any assistant within Catalyze/GDHQ, details on task types it can autonomously complete, and independent/hands-on confirmation of its capabilities.
